alerts.title: Bridge K on Kingsnake Trail Out
alerts.description: Bridge K on Kingsnake Trail is currently out, awaiting replacement. Please use extreme caution if going around this bridge, as it crosses a slough. Water here may be 2-3 feet deep, or deeper.

alerts.title: Paddling Conditions
alerts.description: Trees down across Cedar Creek between Bannister's Bridge and South Cedar Creek may require significant portages depending on water levels & paddlers should plan accordingly. All paddlers should have necessary equipment, including the 10 Essentials.

alerts.title: Backcountry Trail Conditions
alerts.description: GPS is necessary on backcountry trails: Oakridge, Boggy Gut (formerly River), and Kingsnake. These trails may be difficult to follow.

alerts.title: Planning Ahead for Transportation
alerts.description: If being dropped off at the park, please ensure you will have a return ride. Taxis and rideshares do not often come out to Congaree, and the bus may be unavailable. Please plan ahead.
